visualCharacteristics.purpose: collapsible legal disclosure / terms and conditions with numbered footnotes, Go back / Back to top links and optional tables

contentPattern.structure: one row per disclosure: label cell (e.g. Important Terms and Conditions) | body cell (intro text, numbered footnote list, paragraphs, links, optional table); a body cell holding only a /fragments/ link loads that fragment

usage: Legal footnotes and terms at the bottom of product and landing pages.
reuseGuidance: Use for any collapsible legal or disclosure text. Add with-table when the body holds bordered tables, with-table-borderless-table for unbordered tables. For FAQ or product-information panels use accordion-feature.
